page.notes: The left column's first entry is a continuation from the previous page; the number "146.176" belongs to it. The number "347" sits beside the "Prædicatio & publicatio" line in the scan, though it may belong to the "faciunt" line above; I placed it on the Prædicatio line. "302" in "& 302" and "305" are printed in old-style figures that look like "3o2" and "3o5"; the first is marked [?]. The "Pontifices" entry appears to lack a page number on its own line. The line "scripturæ non tantùm" is the first line of the right column, and its opening word may be a continuation of the previous page. Long s has been written as s throughout.
